history: Initial metadata readiness was too restrictive for actual MapLibre6 tile events without sourceDataType; corrected tile completion handling and its positive regression test.
Initial map fixture returned PNG bytes for vector .pbf requests; corrected the fixture, preserving real optional-error isolation rather than broadening error suppression.
Independent validation found a late foreground-anchor style.load ordering race; deferred chart attachment through a guarded microtask and reproduced the repair before final browser acceptance.
An initial publication browser assumed the ROOT-only ordered-plan layer; the final shared harness requires all baseline GeoJSON foreground layers and records plan capability separately.
All preparatory timeout/source-freeze/capability failures remain unaccepted historical local artifacts.

An actual default-view publisher run found valid fully transparent grayscale-alpha PNGs at the tested z13 positions. The original RGBA-only guard rejected them. Final source admits verified 8-bit PNG types4/6 and deliberately selects native max12, overzooming the observed nonempty parent. This does not claim all provider z13 tiles are empty. All source/unit/app/browser checks were renewed on final pins.

Merge f4c16e4 retains both airport and OFM middleware/test sets and complete shared records; inherited package missing comma and blank-index whitespace repaired. An initial parallel-CI assurance CLI child timeout was resolved by serial85-case renewal and a passing complete merged CI. The current publication browser was renewed with its changed Vite pin; OFM source/controller/practice-map bytes are unchanged.
